'''Grik Sonosan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] who served as a spy for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Grik was carrying information about [[Nomen Karr]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]] that he kept secret until he was captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. interrogated by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. To Baras' frustration, Grik refused to crack, as if some unknown power was shielding his mind. After sending his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] into the [[Dark Temple]] to retrieve an ancient torture and interrogation device known as the [[Ravager (device)|Ravager]], Baras used it to finally break Grik's resistance.

[[File:Ravager.png|thumb|left|150px|The Ravager is used on Grik Sonosan.]]
Under the Ravager's influence, Grik confirmed he was an [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] agent investigating a suspected Imperial [[Dellocon|spy]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] on behalf of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Nomen Karr]]. Baras was incensed by knowing that his old nemesis was out to prove that the Empire had spies in the Republic and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ranks and demanded to know what had alerted Karr. Grik explained that Karr was training a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] with the unique ability to discern one's true nature with a glance. Karr believed [[Jaesa Willsaam|his Padawan's]] ability to be foolproof, but the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] remained skeptical, so Karr took the spy-hunting into his own hands. Grik was to provide the proof but was captured before being able to do so.

Knowing that even with this bit of relief, the Padawan was still a threat, Baras demanded Grik to tell him everything he knew about her. Grik stated that the Padawan was from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and trained on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and that Jedi had sent an investigator to root out a suspected spy on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. But before he could give anything more, the Ravager liquefied his mind, killing him.
